value.value: The labeled cluster replaces natural-abundance phenylacetic acid with PhCH2-13CO2H using cited preparations 43 and 45. Indium acetate, labeled acid and P(SiMe3)3 are precursor identities; full cluster charge, reaction conditions and isolation are not reproduced in this paper.
